scope: Coax owns fixture selection/packing, mode and case planning, source/current-compiler gate, emission/cache identity, compilation, exact retained observations, tolerance/count/verdict logic and all child deadlines. Existing IEEE codec supplies only exact number words; no new GPU execution.

native.unchanged_rule: All RGBA finite; absolute error<=1e-7, inclusive. No mask or tolerance changes.

same_input_parity.control_scope: Inclusive1e-7, adjacent larger binary64 error, both signs, nonfinite values and decoded/sampled status failures.
same_input_parity.format_note: JSON number spelling is not normalized to fake byte parity; exact IEEE binary64 observations are compared through the unchanged independent codec.

cache_controls.cache_scope: Exact owned admission integrity, including compiler/C/header/profile/source map; not authentication of hostile forged filesystem receipts.

source_path_correction: First new image passed arithmetic but used a relative entry, changing generated source provenance strings. It was corrected to the original absolute entry and the changed image requalified; final C/header bytes are identical. Earlier receipts/artifacts/logs remain retained without claiming that old overwritten observer image is current.

ieee_oracle.role: numeric_words JSON/struct conversion only; no case selection, budgets, tolerances or driver verdicts.

limitations: Only bounded58/72/7 filter fixtures per native mode; no new device observation, universal precision, Grid/raster/geometry or model gate.
The selected older compiler remains explicitly exploratory; final current-source compiler and release qualification remain pending.
